chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 One Stimulus (7 points) — Set 2: comparative advantage & agriculture/development
chunks.content: AP Human Geography FRQ 2 (One Stimulus, here economic charts), 7 points, parts A–G, one each. Set 2 answer key by part: A [1] define comparative advantage; B [1] describe an effect of Green Revolution technologies on food supplies; C [1] explain how advances in agricultural technology may increase carrying capacity; D [1] explain the degree to which the economies of Country X and Country Y are (e.g., interdependent/similar); E [1] explain how the charts provide limited information about economic development; F/G [1 each] further explain-level tasks. Common failure: describe/define answers without characteristics; explain answers that describe rather than give a mechanism; not addressing chart limitations in E.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 7/7
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 7/7 — defined comparative advantage, described a Green Revolution effect, and explained carrying capacity, cross-country economic relationships, and chart limitations. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 5/7
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 5/7 — earned the define/describe parts and some explain parts, losing about two explain-level points (commonly the 'degree to which' economic comparison or the chart-limitation explanation). Illustrates a solid response short on the higher-order explanation tasks.

chunks.subject: AP Human Geography
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 2/7
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 2/7 — earned only about two lower-skill parts (define/describe), losing the explain-level parts. Illustrates a low response that defines terms but cannot explain mechanisms or interpret the charts' limits.
